idea-plugin.name: Bitbucket Cloud PR Review
idea-plugin.description:
Review Bitbucket Cloud pull requests inside IntelliJ IDEA with git work trees, inline comments, and workspace-wide triage.

  • 🔐 Secure authentication signs you in to Bitbucket Cloud with OAuth so tokens are obtained and stored safely through the IDE.
  • 🪟 A Bitbucket Cloud PR Review tool window on the bottom strip keeps pull request triage inside IntelliJ instead of the browser.
  • 🌳 Opening a PR spins up a separate PR Work Tree project window with its own git work tree so reviews never clash with your main branch or other PRs.
  • 📂 The Current Project tab shows open and completed PRs for the repo in your IDE, with repo links, open-PR counts, reviewer avatars, refresh, and persistent Exclude filters.
  • 🧭 The Workspace tab merges PRs you opened and review assignments from watched projects into one newest-first list across your Bitbucket workspace.
  • 👀 Watched Projects controls which repositories contribute to the workspace queue, with search by slug, folder, PR number, or branch and a master checkbox for matching rows.
  • 📋 Each PR gets a dedicated <prNum>.pr tab plus a blue header stripe with line-change stats, refresh, file changes, and merge, approve, draft, or decline actions.
  • 🕐 The PR Activity timeline mixes commits, approvals, tasks, builds, and file or inline comment threads in time order, with a box to add PR-scoped comments and reply in threads.
  • 📁 The PR Changes tool window lists every file in the diff; picking a file opens it in the editor or diff view driven from the stripe's Show pull request file changes button.
  • ✏️ Modified File View and Diff View surface existing comments and let you add line-level feedback from the gutter or context menu, view add/remove counts, and mark files reviewed.
  • 🚀 Create Pull Request walks you through title, description, source and destination branches, reviewers (including defaults), remote cleanup after merge, then opens the new PR in a work tree window.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Bugfix: Unable to leave multiple comments on same line, thanks Olszewski-Jakub!
  • Fixed: keyboard input in diff and file-editor comment boxes (including paste) edits the comment instead of the read-only file
  • Changed: reply, edit, line, and file comment boxes take focus when opened and keep their text and focus when comments refresh; reply and edit boxes close if the comment was deleted or resolved elsewhere
  • Fixed: inline and file comments on added files appear in the file diff view, as in the file editor
  • Fixed: "Add Comment" in added-file, deleted-file, and unified diffs opens the correct comment UI; deleted-file comments are created on the pull request and shown on the pull request page
  • Changed: Bitbucket sign-in uses OAuth or an API token
  • Removed: Overview, Conversation, and Changes tabs on the pull request page; that content is on one page, and changed files are listed in the PR Changes tool window
  • Added: PR Changes tool window from "Show changed files" in a work tree — file list with line and comment counts, branch names only in the header, Enter to open the selected diff, purple tick instead of line counts for viewed files, and optional diff navigation over unviewed files only
  • Changed: the History card is renamed Activity; commits, approvals, tasks, builds, and comment threads appear in chronological order, with the main comment box at the top
  • Changed: opening a PR work tree while the project is on that PR's branch switches to the main branch first; uncommitted changes trigger a warning instead of switching
  • Added: a local REST endpoint at /api/bbcloud/open on the IDE built-in server, used by the bbcloud Chrome extension to open a pull request in its own work tree from bitbucket.org. The IDE must be running; open requests are accepted only from the extension origin
